name: Prospect dashboard
ownerWords:
and can you setup Posthog tracking and Posthog dashboard for this Prospect & monitoring feature vertical? (2026-11-03, msg mw02k8m4)

왤캐 텅텅비어있노 걔라도 보여야되는거 아님? (2026-11-03, msg mw08t1g0, on the dashboard)
goal: The owner's PostHog dashboard 'Prospect and Watchlist' (https://us.posthog.com/project/354457/dashboard/2295680) shows data in every tile when he opens it, and stays fed. Build step p289 is done, so keeping it fed is upkeep (c110). The headline counts the insight tiles that load with no error and return a number, run the way the dashboard loads them. A true 0 counts as fed (launch VP, 11-04); an error, a missing source, no row, or rows of only names and blanks where numbers belong count as empty. The customer filter of every tile reads the PostHog warehouse tables prodconvex_orgs and prodconvex_orgmembers, which PostHog's Google Cloud Storage source syncs hourly from the files that the us-metal02 timer posthog-warehouse-sync writes from self-hosted convex-prod (auto-sns-agent ops/posthog-warehouse/README.md, since 11-08, when the Convex source 01a17c34 that could read only *.convex.cloud was replaced); from 17:39Z on 11-03 to 01:49Z on 11-04 the old source sat paused with 3 failed tables during the Convex outage and nothing noticed, so the source's tables and the writer's last run are a metric. The precheck finds the source by its prodconvex_orgs table, since the hardcoded old id answered 404 on 11-09. The State and Does it work tiles read the daily prod events prospect_state_day and watchlist_reads_day (convex/crons.ts runs search/pipeDays.fillDay at 04:41Z; registry ~/.pi/wiki/content/domains/product-analytics/posthog-events.yaml), so their age is a metric. On the first run (11-04 about 05:50Z) prod Convex befitting-sparrow-356 ran b1fb45b230, the 11-02 land, which holds no prospectStateDay.ts, so prod had never sent either event and 11 of 18 tiles read empty under the first rule; the 11-03 04:42Z events in 354457 came from the us-metal02 local backend with dev org ids, so the event ages count only events whose orgId is a prod Convex org.

metrics.label: Tiles of the Prospect and Watchlist dashboard whose query runs clean and returns a number, a true 0 included

Tables of the PostHog prod warehouse source that a tile reads or that sync, which are paused, failed, or last synced over twice their interval ago, plus its file writer when its last run failed or is over 2 h old
Hours since the newest prod prospect_state_day event, due once a day after the 04:41Z cron
Hours since the newest prod watchlist_reads_day event, due once a day after the 04:41Z cron

onMiss: Read the flagged slices first. source_tables_failing: each table_failing slice names the table and why. A posthog-warehouse-sync.service slice means the writer failed or stopped: read `systemctl --user status posthog-warehouse-sync.service` and ~/.local/state/virev/posthog-warehouse-sync.log on us-metal02 and fix it as ops/posthog-warehouse/README.md says. A PostHog table slice is fixed in the run with POSTHOG_ADMIN_API_KEY (auto-sns-agent apps/search/.env through node_modules/.bin/dotenvx get): PATCH https://us.posthog.com/api/projects/354457/external_data_schemas/<schema id>/ with should_sync true, which starts a sync at once, or POST .../external_data_sources/<source id>/reload/ for the GCS source whose schemas hold prodconvex_orgs, then read .../jobs/ for rows_synced. Event ages: first read which commit prod runs with `node scripts/repo/convex/call.mjs revision convex-prod` in auto-sns-agent. When that commit holds no convex/search/campaigns/prospectStateDay.ts, the senders are waiting on a prod promote, which the release owner walks with the owner (c154): tell the CI and RepoOps thread once with the reading, never dispatch or ask for a promote, and open no fix step. When prod holds the senders and the events still do not land, give one fix step with duty "<dutyId>/<metric key>" and one fix job (rlm.create_session) that reads otel.otel_logs through ops/bin/ch-ro prod for search/pipeDays:fillDay, prospectStateDay:send and '[posthog]' lines, checks prod's PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (capturePostHog in convex/lib/posthog.ts sends nothing and logs nothing without it, or from a deployment whose CONVEX_CLOUD_URL it does not know as production or staging), and lands the fix on dev/sieun. tiles_with_data_pct: a tile_failing slice is a HogQL error or timeout, and a tile_empty slice is a tile with no row or only blanks; the job 'prospect dashboard tiles fill' (p304) owns the tile queries in ~/work/prospect-posthog/dashboard.py, so send it the slices while it is live, else give one fix step and one fix job. A tile_empty whose events are late is the same cause as the event age, so fix that first. Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
